title: V3 final group 02 original Java upgrade caller replays
description: Repeat the corpus with JDBC driver selection checked in fresh JVMs when the original caller reports no suitable driver. Bind provider declarations and classfile versions to the original JARs and keep the downstream operation open. Retain the qualified dispatch and runtime linkage evidence. Run strict native and finite checks on both revisions, keeping original intake failures, pre-entry exceptions, and per-input replay evidence. Cases compsuite-i-10, compsuite-i-103, compsuite-i-29, compsuite-i-36, compsuite-i-37, compsuite-i-39.
